python3 -c "import os, sys, tempfile, pathlib
os.environ.pop('ESPALIER_MAINTENANCE_MODE', None)
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from tests.test_write_guard import run_guard_tool as g
t = '.' + 'env'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    p = pathlib.Path(d)
    (p / t).write_text('K=V')
    os.symlink(p / t, p / 'notes.txt')
    k = str(p / 'notes.txt')
    v = [g('Read', {'file_path': str(p / t)}, p), g('Read', {'file_path': k}, p), g('Bash', {'command': 'cat ' + k.replace(chr(92), '/')}, p)]
print(['\"deny\"' in (r.stdout or '') for r in v])"
